repetitions: 5 independent full runs; correctness/routing numbers are deterministic byte-for-byte (bench-harness's own documented methodology -- only latency has genuine run-to-run variance)

headline_result.fitment_ndcg_at_10_mean: 0.9913 (n=8, min=0.9306) -- the new many-to-many fitment structural relationship generalizes cleanly via the pre-existing MultiEnum/MultiEnumContains mechanism, no production code changes
headline_result.aggregate_ndcg_all_templates: ~0.422-0.425 (deterministic; dominated by the disclosed exact_lookup finding below, 31/57=54% of the workload)
headline_result.failure_taxonomy: 35.1% entity_resolved_structural, 56.1% no_structural_signal_punt, 8.8% vocabulary_gap_demoted_to_punt (P9-E05 regression check reproduced against unseen vocabulary, still fires correctly)
headline_result.latency_p50_ms: ~0.099ms in 4/5 runs (run4 outlier 0.132ms), sub-millisecond throughout -- not comparable to Phase 9's WANDS-scale latency (far smaller synthetic catalog)
headline_result.named_finding_exact_lookup: part_number is a variant-level AttributeValue::Text attribute; the reused phase9_eval::bitmap_delegate::build_index only indexes product-level Text into its Tantivy fields (an existing, documented Phase 9 scope decision, confirmed by direct source read, not a new defect) -- so exact_lookup (part-number search) queries never match via the Hybrid/Punt lexical delegate path, even though commerce_core::index::CatalogIndex's own internal lexical_postings does cover variant text (unused by plan::execute_planned). Disclosed as a schema-management-relevant finding for any future production LexicalDelegate, not patched here (out of E2's scope, shared Phase-9 infra).
